as_told.title: Retrieved craft 'born secret' under the Atomic Energy Act

plain: A former US intelligence officer, David Grusch, says that the Atomic Energy Act of 1954, a US law that keeps nuclear matters secret, defines "special nuclear material" so broadly that it covers almost any material that gives off atomic energy, which he says would include material from crashed craft of unknown origin. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, repeats the point and goes further, saying the wording was chosen in a sneaky, deliberate way to protect UFO secrets, and that anything recovered is "born secret" under the law. If true, it would mean that an old nuclear law quietly keeps crash material hidden from the public.
